rnams ni snang ba'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni skyabs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni mgon no/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni ma'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ bsam gtan rnams ni lam mo/ /bsam gtan rnams ni snang ba'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni sgron ma 'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ bsam gtan rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /bsam gtan rnams ni skyabs so/ /bsam gtan rnams ni mgon no/ /bsam gtan rnams ni ma'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni pha'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ tshad myed pa rnams ni lam mo/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni snang ba'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni skyabs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni mgon no/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni ma'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni pha'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni lam mo/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni snang ba'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni skyabs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mgon no/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa

rnams ni ma'o/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni pha'o/ /rnam par thar ba brgyad ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ rnam par thar pa brgyad ni lam mo/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni snang ba'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'i shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni dpung gnyen no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni skyabs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni mgon no/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni/ ma'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni/ pha'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni lam mo/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni snang ba'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni dpung gnyen no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni skyabs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni mgon no/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni ma'o/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni pha'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni lam mo/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni snang ba'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo

stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni dpung gnyen no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ni skyabs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa ni mgon no/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa ni ma'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni pha'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni lam mo/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni snang ba'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni/ sgron ma'o/ /blo'o/ /shes pa'o/ /shes rab bo/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni/ dpung gnyen no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni/ skyabs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mgon no/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni ma'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni pha'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ni lam mo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni snang ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni skyabs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni mgon no/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni pha'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni lam mo/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni snang ba'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni dpung gnyen no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni skyabs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo

rnams ni mgon no/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni ma'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni pha'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni lam mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni snang ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni dpung gnyen no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni skyabs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni mgon no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni pha'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni lam mo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni lam mo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni snang ba'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni dpung gnyen no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni skyabs so/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni mgon no/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni ma'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni pha'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni lam mo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni snang ba'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni dpung gnyen no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni skyabs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni mgon no/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni ma'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni pha'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni lam mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni snang ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'i shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni dpung gnyen no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni skyabs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni mgon no/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni ma'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni pha'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston par rig par bya ste/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam mo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni snang ba'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni sgron ma'o/ /blo'o shes pa'o shes rab bo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni dpung gnyen no/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni skyabs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni mgon no/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni ma'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni pha'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spong bar byed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag ni 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi yang yab dang yum du gyur to/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi yang yab dang yum du 'gyur ro/ /

rab 'byor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag ni da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi yang yab dang yum du gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar 'di las byung ba ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams te/ rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar 'dod pa dang / sems can yongs su smyin par bya bar 'dod pas bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can rnams yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pa dang / tshig snyan pa dang / don spyad pa dang / don mthun pa ste/ rab 'byor ngas don gyi dbang de mthong bas 'di skad du 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ston pa dang / ma dang pha dang dpung gnyen dang skyabs dang mgon yin no zhes brjod do/ /rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan gyi dring myi 'jog par bya bar 'dod pa dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa la gnas par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tsom gcad par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar 'dod pa dang / sems can yongs su smyin par bya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos gang la bslab par bya ba de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa 'di las rgya cher bstan to/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa'i mtshan nyid ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan nyid myed pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mtshan nyid gang yang med do/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mtshan nyid gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchis pa'i mtshan nyid des chos thams cad mchis par 'gyur ba'i rnam grangs de lta bu mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ mtshan nyid gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod pa'i mtshan nyid de nyid kyis chos thams cad yod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin kyis dben pa ste/ chos thams cad ni chos thams cad kyis dben pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni chos thams cad kyis stong pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na 'di ltar stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang / dben pa'i mtshan nyid du mtshan nyid gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod pa'i mtshan nyid des chos thams cad yod do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyis dben la/ chos thams cad kyang chos thams cad kyis stong na/ sems can rnams kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba yang ji ltar mchis par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das dben pa ni kun nas nyon mongs par mi 'gyur/ rnam par byang bar myi 'gyur/ stong pa nyid ni kun nas nyon mongs par myi 'gyur/ rnam par byang bar myi 'gyur/ dben pa dang stong pa nyid ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon

par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya/ dben pas ni stong pa nyid la byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i chos gang yang myi dmyigs/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang dben pa la sems can gang byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de lta bu myi dmyigs na/ bcom ldan 'das bstan pa de'i don bdag gis ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sems can rnams yun ring po nas bdag dang bdag gi zhes bya ba la spyod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de de lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de de lags te/ sems can rnams ni yun ring po nas bdag tu bgyi ba dang / bdag gir bgyi ba la spyod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ bdag dang bdag gi zhes bya ba dben pa yin zhing / bdag dang bdag gi zhes bya ba stong pa yin mod/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dben pa lags so/ bde bar gshegs pa stong pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ bdag dang bdag gi zhes bya bas sems can rnams kun tu rgyug cing kun tu 'khor ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de de lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de de lags te/ bdag tu bgyi ba dang bdag gir bgyi bas sems can rnams kun tu rgyug cing kun tu 'khor bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar na sems can rnams kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa yod pa yin te/ gang la bdag tu bya ba myed pa dang / bdag gir bya ba myed pa de la 'dzin pa myed/ gang la 'dzin pa myed pa de la sems can kun tu rgyug cing kun tu 'khor ba med de/ de la kun nas nyon mongs pa gang yang myed pas/ rab 'byor de ltar na sems can rnams kyi

rnam par byang ba yod pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod pa ni/ gzugs la myi spyod/ tshor ba la mi spyod/ 'du shes la mi spyod/ 'du byed la myi spyod/ rnam par shes pa la myi spyod do/ /myig la myi spyod/ rna ba la myi spyod/ sna la mi spyod/ lce la myi spyod/ lus la myi spyod/ yid la myi spyod do/ /gzugs la myi spyod/ sgra la myi spyod/ dri la myi spyod/ ro la mi spyod/ reg la myi spyod/ chos la myi spyod do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa la myi spyod/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la myi spyod/ sna'i rnam par shes pa la myi spyod/ lce'i rnam par shes pa la mi spyod/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa la myi spyod/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa la mi spyod do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa la mi spyod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la mi spyod/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa la myi spyod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa la myi spyod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la mi spyod/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la myi spyod do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la myi spyod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba la mi spyod/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la myi spyod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la myi spyod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la myi spyod/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la myi spyod do/ /sa'i khams la myi spyod/ chu'i khams la mi spyod/ mye'i khams la myi spyod/ rlung gi khams la mi spyod/ nam mkha'i khams la myi spyod/ rnam par shes pa'i khams la myi spyod do/ /ma rig pa la myi spyod do/ /'du byed la myi spyod/ rnam par shes pa la myi spyod/ ming dang gzugs la myi spyod/ skye mched drug la mi spyad/ reg pa la myi spyod/ tshor ba la myi spyod/ sred pa la myi spyod/ len pa la myi spyod/

srid pa la myi spyod/ skye ba la myi spyod/ rga shi la mi spyod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mi spyod/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod do/ /nang stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ phyi stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la mi spyod/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la mi spyod/ chen po stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mi spyod/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la myi spyod/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mi spyod/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la mi spyod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la myi spyod/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la myi spyod/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la mi spyod/ dbang po rnams la myi spyod/ stobs rnams la mi spyod/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la myi spyod/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la mi spyod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la mi spyod/ bsam gtan rnams la myi spyod/ tshad med pa rnams la mi spyod/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mi spyod/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la myi spyod/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la myi spyod/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la myi spyod/ mngon par shes pa rnams la myi spyod/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la myi

spyod/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la myi spyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la myi spyod/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi la myi spyod/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la mi spyod/ byams pa chen po la mi spyod/ snying rje chen po la myi spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la myi spyod/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la myi spyod/ dgra bcom pa nyid la myi spyod/ rang byang chub la mi spyod/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la myi spyod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la myi spyod do/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang spyod pa dang / gang gis spyod pa dang / gang la spyod par 'gyur ba'i chos de dag thams cad mi dmigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis myi thub pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis zil gyis gnon par myi nus so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon ma mchis pa'i gnas zil gyis myi non pa la gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la bgyid pa dang ma bral ba ni zil gyis myi non pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang nye bar gyur pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub

tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa de la rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gror byas/ bkur sti byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang

rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par mi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti byas phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas/ rnam par spyod na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par

rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par mi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur la/ de dag nam 'tsho'i bar du bzhugs pa la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis rim gro byas/ bkur sti byas/ phu dud byas/ mchod pa byas te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas rnam par spyod na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi med par mi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang /

rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal ta stong gi 'jig

rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston cing 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi med par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi

la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad myed pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur la/ de dag rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la rab tu bkod pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu

la rab tu bkod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu bkod pa dang / Rang byang chub la rab tu bkod pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngos na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzhan la ston pa dang / 'chad pa dang / rnam par gzhog pa dang / rab tu gzhog pa dang / 'grel pa dang / rnam par 'byed pa dang / gsal bar byed pa dang / yang dag par ston na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /rab 'byor de ltar spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ rnam par 'byed pa ni sems can thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gro ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par spyod pa de lta bu ni sems can gang la yang myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byams pa chen po mngon par bsgrub ste/ de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad gsad par 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar lta ste/ de dag snying rje chen po 'thob bo/ /de dag rnam par spyod pa des/ rnam par spyod pas dga'

bas rab tu dga' ba dang / mngon par dga' bar 'gyur te/ de dag dga' ba chen po mngon par sgrub bo/ /de dag mtshan ma de dang lhan cig tu mi gnas te/ de dag btang snyoms chen po 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi snang ba chen po ste/ 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu de dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas kyang / sems can thams cad kyi sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog go /de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rnam par spyod pa'i phyir/ su'i gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang / nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang / yo byad la yongs su spyod pa'i gtong ba dang / sbyin bdag gi sbyin pa dag par 'gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang yang nye bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don yod par khams kyi bsod snyoms la yongs su spyod par 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi lam bstan par 'dod pa dang / snang ba chen po dbyung bar 'dod pa dang / khams gsum gyi btson ran gnas pa'i sems can rnams yongs su dgrol bar 'dod pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bla na med pa'i shes rab kyi myig bskyed par 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gnas par bya'o/ /gal te byang

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas rnam par mi spyod na yang / des yid la bya ba gzhan gyi go skabs myi da bye ste/ des ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba nyid kyis nyin mtshan du mi gtong zhing brtson par gnas pa de ltar bya'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na sngon cad nor bu rin po che rnyed ma myong ba'i skyes bu zhig yod la des dus gzhan zhig na nor bu rin po che rnyed par gyur te/ des nor bu rin po che de rnyed pas dga' ba dang spro ba dang yid bde ba dang ldan par gyur pa las/ des nor bu rin po che de rnyed ma thag tu stor bar gyur na/ de'i rgyus sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par kyi hud bdag ni yid du 'ong ba'i nor bu rin po che de dang bral bar gyur to zhes nor bu rin po che dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba sha stag rgyun du 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di ni rin po che'o snyam du bsams te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rin po che de stor bar yang myi bya ste/ de ltar na rtag tu bde ba dang / yid bde ba mang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yid la bgyi ba de dag thams cad kyang rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ yid la bgyi ba thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis stong pa lags na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bgyi ba dang ma bral ba lags/ bral ba la ni byang chub sems dpa' myi dmyigs/ yid la bgyi ba myi dmyigs/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te byang chub

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di ltar chos thams cad ni rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de dag ni nyan thos kyis ma byas/ rang sangs rgyas kyis ma byas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang ma mdzad de/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' 'di ni gnas pa yin no/ /zhes bya bar shes na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin gyis dben/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste/ de la 'phel ba myed do/ /yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rang bzhin gyis dben zhing rang bzhin gyis stong pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par byung zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par byung yang 'phel ba 'am yongs su 'grib pa myed de/ de bzhin nyid la 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa med do/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'phel ba'am yongs su 'grib pa myed do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' la 'phel ba 'am yongs su 'grib pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gcig kyang ma yin gnyis kyang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor gal te de skad du bshad pa la/ byang

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi 'jum mi 'gong / myi 'jigs myi sngang skrag par mi 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni phyir myi ldog pa'i dbyings la gnas pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes bya bar rtogs par rig par bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun pa/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gso ba nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa gang lags pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gud na gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i chos gang yang dmigs su mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stong pa nyid las gud du stong pa nyid spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/

bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du byed shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci lags/ sna shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sgra shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dri shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ro shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ reg shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byord kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom

ldan 'das ci lags/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sa'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chu'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mye'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rlung gi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ nam mkha'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa'i khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ma rig pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'du byed shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par shes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mying dang gzugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/

skye mched drug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ reg pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshor ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sred pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ len pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ srid pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ skye ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rga shi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ nang stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyi stong pa nyid shes

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyi nang stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chen po stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ don dam pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dor ba med pa/ stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la

spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dbang po lnga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ stobs lnga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bsam gtan bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ tshad myed pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par thar pa brgyad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mngon par shes pa rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/

bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ ting nge 'dzin rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ snying rje chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dgra bcom pa nyid/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang byang chub/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ gzugs kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang /
