bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byams pa chen po'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ snying rje chen po'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma

mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswo brgyad kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gso ba nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang /

chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyodam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gso ba nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyodam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rang byang chub kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid dang / gsog nyid dang / gsob nyid dang / rag lus pa nyid dang / snying po ma mchis pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i chos de khyod kyis mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

de lta bu khyod kyis mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang khyod kyis ma mthong ba'i chos de dmigs su yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ chos gang dmigs su myed pa de skye ba 'am 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa ste/ rab 'byor bzod pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/ rab 'byor 'di ni stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i lam zhes bya ste/ lam der zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar spyod de ltar rtsol/ de ltar 'bad pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes/ ye shes chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par myi 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i phyir te/ de'i chos de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang yongs su 'grib par myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ chos thams cad kyi myi skye ba nyid gang lags pa de las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'

chen po de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ skye ba yang ma lags/ myi skye ba yang ma lags pa las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan tam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te skye ba yang ma lags/ mi skye ba yang ma lags pa las kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung mi bstan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu khyod kyis yang dag par rjes su mthong ngam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das chos gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'gyur ba'i chos de dag ni bdag gis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das chos gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gang gis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi ba de lta bu'i chos kyang bdag gis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni 'di snyam du bdag ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /

'dis ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /'di ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /zhes bya bar myi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa de thams cad myed pa'i phyir te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par myi rtog pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bzhi bcu lnga'o// //de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du zab pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du blta dka' ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du brtag tu ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du brtag pa'i spyod yul ma lags pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du zhi ba phra ba zhib pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu dben pa'i slad du mkhas shing rig pas rtogs par bgyi ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan bgyid cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs

par sangs rgyas kyi bar du sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go mi 'byed pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tha ma dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ sems can gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyan cing / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang zhing klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go myi 'byed pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tha ma dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan par gyur la/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang la/ glog cing kun chub par byed par gyur te/ bzung zhing bcangs/ blags shing kun chub par byas nas kyang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed na/ kau shi ka dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la snga ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /bye ba'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba'i brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /grangs dang cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dpe dang

rgyur yang myi bzod do/ /de nas dge slong gcig cig gis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan pa/ tshad myed pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa de dag thams cad ni/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi g.yeng ba'i sems kyis 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos gzhan gyi go myi 'byed pa de dag gis zil gyis non to/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dge slong de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/ bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan pa/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems dang po bskyed pas kyang zil gyis non na/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / bzung zhing bcangs te/ blags shing kun chub par byas nas kyang de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis gnon par

'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang zil gyis mnan cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas su yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang zil gyis gnon cing 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod par yang ma zad de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji skad du bstan pa bzhin du spyod pa de dag ni lha dang myi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan par myi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji skad du bstan pa dang mthun par spyod pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rigs rgyun myi gcad pa'i don du gnas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni de bzhin gshegs pa ring du mi byed pa'o/ /de ltar zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni snying po byang chub dang phang bar myi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/ sems can bying ba rnams gdon par 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob pa ste/ nyan thos kyi bslab pa la

slob pa ma yin no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa la slob pa ma yin no/ /de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang 'gro bar bya bar sems te nye bar dong zhing 'di skad ces smra'o/ /kye skyes bu chen po myur du slobs shig /skyes bu chen po skyen par slobs shig /lhung bzed bzhi po 'di dag ni khyod kyis snying po byang chub tu 'dug ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas blang bar bya ba ste/ 'di dag ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzhes pa'o zhes zer zhing ston to/ /de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'dod par sems so/ /de'i drung du bdag kyang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma yang / mtshe ma'i lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan yang dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul dga' yang / 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur yang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /tshangs pa myi mjed kyi bdag po yang tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang lhan cig 'gro bar sems so/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par

sems so/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyang nye bar 'dod par sems so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang rtag tu dgongs pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la de ltar spyod pa de'i lus la ni 'jig rten pa'i sdug bsngal gzhan gyis gnod par byas pa gang ji snyed cig lus la 'byung ba de dag kyang thams cad du thams cad lus la myi 'byung myi 'bab ste/ dge slong de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di'i yon tan du 'gyur ba ste/ 'dus pa'i nad rnams gang ji snyed pa 'di lta ste/ myig gi nad dam/ rna ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lus kyi nad dam/ snying gi nad gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang lus la myi 'byung myi 'bab ste/ 'di dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di'i yon tan du rig par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 'di snyam du gyur te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di rang gi spobs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan dang legs pa rjod dam/ 'on te sangs rgyas kyi mthus ston snyam pa dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i sems kyi yongs su rtog pa sems kyis yongs su shes nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga'

bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo bdag de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan dang legs pa rjod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi mthur rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ston pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i yon tan dang / legs pa rjod pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'o/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs so/ /kun dga' bo gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par byed pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgom pa de'i tshe/ gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bdud sdig to can gang ji snyed cig yod pa de thams cad ci byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byas te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / Rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ram/ 'on te ma yin gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur snyam ste/ dogs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ bdud sdig to can mya ngan gyi zug rngus zug par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bdud sdig to can ci nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di rnam pa thams

cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la byed pa las sems gcig tsam 'khrug par 'gyur ba dang / zhum par 'gyur ba dang / spu g.yo bar 'gyur bar skar ma ltung bar gtong zhing 'jigs pa skyed do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas mchi bar 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas 'ong ba ma yin no/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'o na ji lta bu'i drung du mchi bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang gis ston gyi mthar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ sems mos par ma byas pa de'i drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'ong ngo / /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ 'on tam ma yin zhes the tsom du gyur pa de dag gi drung du bdud sdig to can gtse ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'ong ngo / /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral na/ des dge ba'i bshes gnyen myi mthong bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi thos so/ /ma thos pas myi shes so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji ltar bsgom pa ma shes pas de bzhin nyid du nan tan myi byed de/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha

rol tu phyin pa dang bral la/ dam pa'i chos ma yin pa yongs su 'dzin pa byed na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i chos ma yin pa la bsngags pa rjod na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ gang dam pa'i chos ma yin pa'i bsngags pa smra ba ni bdag gi grogs yin te/ gang dam pa'i chos ma yin pa'i bsngags pa smra ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa mang po'i nang nas/ bdag gis grogs su rnyed pa ste/ de ltar gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa 'di lta ste/ nyan thos kyi sa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa gnyis las gcig tu gnas par 'gyur ba ni/ de bdag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o snyam ste/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ji lta bu la bdud kyis glags rnyed par 'gyur zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ 'di skad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shin tu zab ste/ khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di thos pas ci zhig bya/ bsgoms pa dang / bzung ba dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par byas pas kyang ci zhig bya/ ngas kyang de'i gting ma rnyed na/ khyod kyis lta rnyed re skan zhes zer na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan la byang chub sems dpa' brnyas pa skyed cing / nga ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu

phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /nga ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /nga ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /nga ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /nga ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /nga ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad pa'o/ /khyod ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /khyod ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ma yin no/ /zhes rlom sems su byed na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid mchog tu rlom sems skyed na/ kun dga' bo de'i tshe bdud sdig to can dga' ba dang / spro ba dang nyams bde ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / tshim zhing yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur te/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' de la yang bdud sdig to can gyis glags rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gang gi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i mying brjod pa'am/ rus brjod pa kun tu grags par gyur na/ de mying brjod pa'am/ rus brjod pa des/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan dge ba'i chos can dag khyad du gsod cing bdag stod gzhan smod la/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam pa dang tshul dang / mtshan mar bya ba'i yon tan de dag kyang de la myed par rnam pa dang tshul dang / mtshan ma myed pa de dag gis nyon mongs pa skyed cing bdag stod gzhan smod de/ 'di skad du ji

ltar nga byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gnas par snang ba de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la gnas par mi snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i rigs la gnas par myi snang ngo zhes de de ltar gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa de dag la mi snyan par rjod cing smod na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi gnas ni stongs par myi 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa dang / yi dgas kyi yul yang shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ci nas kyang de'i tshig gzung du rung bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar bdud sdig to can byang chub sems dpa' de byin gyis rlob ste/ de'i tshig gzung du rung bas skye bo mang po dag kyang mnyan pa dang / yid ches par bya bar sems te/ de la de dag gis thos sam mthong na/ mthun par spyod par 'gyur te/ de dag gis thos sam mthong nas mthun par spyod cing de bzhin du slob ste/ de dag de bzhin du slob pa'i tshe de bzhin nyid du slob cing / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pa shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ de ltar de dag bsam pa phyin ci log tu gyur pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis las gang dang gang brtsams pa de thams cad mi 'dod pa dang / myi sdug pa dang yid du mi 'ong bar 'grub par 'gyur te/ de ltar na sems can dmyal ba chen po de dag kyang rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul yang rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ bdud kyi gnas kyang shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ kun dga' bo don gyi dbang de mthong nas/ bdud sdig to can dga' ba dang / spro ba dang tshim pa dang / yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gal

te gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang rtsod cing nga ni mchog tu gyur pa yin gyi/ khyod ni ma yin no zhes zer na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ kye rigs kyi bu 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ring du byed pa ste/ 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang nye bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'thab mo dang 'khrug pa dang rtsod pa dang mtshang 'dru ba 'di dag ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam ma yin te/ de ni sems can dmyal ba'i lam mo/ /de ni byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam mo/ /de ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam mo/ /de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ma yin no snyam du sems par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dang / gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa can gzhan du 'thab cing rtsod la/ 'khrug cing mtshang 'dru na/ de la bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di gnyis ka yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ring du byed pa'o/ /'di gnyis ka yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang myi rgya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis kyis gang brtsams pa de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam ma yin/ rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis kyis ni sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi lam brtsams so zhes nas dga' zhing spro ba dang / tshim zhing yid bde ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang gal te byang chub sems dpa' lung ma bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa la gnod par sems shing / 'thab cing rtsod la 'khrug cing mtshang 'dru na/ gal te des rnam

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su mi gtang zhe na/ ci tsam du sdig pa'i sems bskyed pa skyes pa dang / 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / 'khrug cing mtshang 'dru bar gyur pa de srid kyi bskal bar go ca bgo bar bya'o/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sems bskyed pa de dag la 'byung ba gzhan ma mchis sam 'on te ma lags kyis bskal pa de snyed kho nar go ca bgo 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa rnams la ngas 'byung ba dang bcas pa'i chos bstan te/ kun dga' bo de la gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag dang / 'thab cing rtsod la gshe zhing myi snyan du brjod pa dang / 'thabs rtsod de gshe ba dang / myi snyan par brjod pa byas nas/ phyir myi 'chags par mdud par 'dzin cing khon tu bzung ste gnas na/ kun dga' bo gang zag de ni 'byung bar nga mi smra ste/ gang zag des gal te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su myi btang zhe na/ gdon mi za bar bskal pa de snyed du go ca bgo bar bya'o/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'thabs shing rtsod de gshe ba dang mi snyan par brjod par gyur na yang / mdud par mi 'dzin la phyin chad sdom pa 'dzin cing / bdag gis ni thob par bya ba nyes par thob ste/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bstsal dgos na/ de ltar bdag smras pa la phyir smra ba dang / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi zam par gyur par bya dgos na/ de ltar bdag gzhan la myi snyan par smra zhing / phyir zlogs pa ni myi tshul gyis/ bdag gis de ltar myi bya'i bdag gis glen pa dang / lkug pa bzhin du bya'o/ /

bdag gi bsam pa la 'khrug pa med par bya'o/ /sems can 'di dag ni bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bya dgos na/ de dag nyid la bdag ngan sems su byed pa dang / de dag nyid la bdag 'khrug pa ni tshul ma yin gyis/ bdag gis de dag la gnod sems su mi bya'o/ /bdag gis de dag la 'khrug par mi bya'o snyam na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni 'byung ba yod par ngas bshad de/ de la ni bdud sdig to can glags lta zhing glags tshol bas kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag dang 'grogs par myi bya'o/ /de dag dang lhan cig tu gnas par myi bya'o/ /'dug par mi bya'o/ /gal te 'dug na yang des su la yang gnod sems su mi bya 'khrug par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang bdag gis 'di dag la gnod sems su bya ba dang / 'khrug par bya ba de ni bdag la myi tshul lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag ni bdag gis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su dgrol bar bya ba dag go snyam du bya'o/ /kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dag dang gnas par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na/ ston pa dang ji ltar gnas pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang zag byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa dang gnas par bya ste/ de ci'i

phyir zhe na/ 'di ni bdag gi grogs te gru gcig tu zhugs pa'o/ /'dis ji ltar bslab par bya ba de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bslab par bya'o/ /'dis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa

bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / thams cad shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang la bslab par bya ba de nyid la bdag gis kyang bslab par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed do/ /des gzhan yang sems 'di ltar bskyed par byas te/ 'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam ston pa ste/ gal te de 'dres par spyod cing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang bral bar gyur na/ de la bdag gis bslab par mi bya'i/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang / ma bral bar gnas na/ bdag gis kyang de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed de/ de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bslab pa mnyam pa yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bzhi bcu drug go/ //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu dgu pa/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byord kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsold to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mnyam pa nyid gang la bslab par bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsald pa/ rab 'byord nang stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord phyi stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /

rab 'byord phyi nang stong pa nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord chen po stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byord rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid do/ /gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / tshor ba ni tshor bas stong / 'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong / 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong / myig ni myig gis stong / rna ba ni rna bas stong / sna ni snas stong / lce ni lces stong / lus ni lus kyis stong / yid ni yid kyis stong / gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / sgra ni sgras stong / dri ni dris stong / ro ni ros stong / reg ni reg gis stong / chos ni chos kyis stong / myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pas stong / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong / sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong / lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pas stong / lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong / myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong / sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong / lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i

rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong / sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong / chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong / mye'i khams ni mye'i khams kyis stong / rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams kyis stong / nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyis stong / rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong / ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong / 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong / mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyis stong / skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong / reg pa ni reg pas stong / tshor ba ni tshor bas stong / sred pa ni sred pas stong / len pa ni len pas stong / srid pa ni srid pas stong / skye ba ni skye bas stong / rga shi ni rga shis stong / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong / nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong / phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong / phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong / don dam pa stong po nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong / mtha' las 'das pa

stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong / chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong / yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong / dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong / stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong / bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong / tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad myed pa rnams kyis stong / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong / rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong / rnam par thar

pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pas stong / mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong / ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong / gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong / mi 'jigs pa rnams ni mi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong / snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen pos stong / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong / dgra bcom pa nyid ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong / rang byang chub ni rang byang chub kyis stong / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid de/ de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du

slob pa lags sam/ gzugs 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ gzugs mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ tshor ba myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du shes mi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed pas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed 'dod chags dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed 'gag par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ 'du byed myi skye bar bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rnam par shes pa bas par bgyi ba'i slad du slob na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du slob pa lags sam/ rnam par

ram/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang pa 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sa'i khams kyi de bzhin nyid

ram/ len pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ srid pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ skye ba'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rga shi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ nang stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid

kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa' ma/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba

'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dbang po lnga'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ stobs lnga'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ bsam gtan bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ tshad myed pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms

par 'jug pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang pa 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ snying rje chen po'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/

'gag par 'gyur ram/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang pa 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ Rang byang chub kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de zad pa'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin nyid la slob pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yin/ de bzhin nyid ni zad pa 'am/ spang ba 'am/ skye ba 'am/ 'gag par 'gyur ba myed de/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin nyid la slob pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phyi stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ chen po stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ thog ma

pa'i stobs bcu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ snying rje chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rang byang chub la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bslab pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'thob par 'gyur ba yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bdud dam bdud kyi

ris kyi lha rnams kyis pham par myi nus pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ myur du phyir myi ldog pa'i sa 'thob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bdag gi pha de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la spyod pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni mgon du 'gyur ba'i chos rnams la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ byams pa chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni snying rje chen po la slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni rnam pa bcu gnyis lan gsum du bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can thams cad yongs su smyin par bya'o zhes slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rgyun myi gcad pa'i phyir slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni 'chi ba med pa'i sgo dbye bar bya'o zhes slob pa yin/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

ni/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams bstan par bya'o/ /zhes slob pa yin te/ rab 'byor sems can dma' bas ni bslab pa rgya chen po 'di la bslab par myi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bslab pa 'dir slob pa de ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las gdon par 'dod pa ste/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can dmyal bar myi skye'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas su myi skye'o/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten du myi skye'o/ /yul mtha' 'khob tu myi skye'o/ /yul gcong rong can du mi skye'o/ /phyag dar pa dang / gdol ba'i rigs su myi skye'o/ /zhar bar myi 'gyur ro/ /sgur por myi 'gyur ro/ /zha bor myi 'gyur ro/ /yan lag skyon can du myi 'gyur ro/ /'on par myi 'gyur ro/ /lag pa med par myi 'gyur ro/ /dbang po dang myi ldan par myi 'gyur te/ dbang po yongs su tshang zhing dbang po ma tshang bar myi 'gyur ro/ /srog gcod par myi 'gyur ro/ /ma byin pa len par myi 'gyur ro/ /'dod pas log par g.yem par myi 'gyur ro/ /brdzun du smra bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phra ma can du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhe gcod pa smra bar mi 'gyur ro/ /tshig kyal pa can du myi 'gyur ro/ /chags sems can du myi 'gyur ro/ /gnod sems can du myi 'gyur ro/ /log par lta bar myi 'gyur ro/ /'tsho ba log pas 'tsho bar myi 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa ma yin pas yongs su 'dzin par myi 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims ngan pa can du myi 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims ngan pa yongs su 'dzin par myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ lha tshe rings po'i nang du myi skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa

gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha tshe rings por myi skye ba'i thabs mkhas pa de lta bu de la yod de/ de yang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid las thabs mkhas pa bstan pa ste/ thabs mkhas pa de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bsam gtan rnams la yang snyoms par 'jug /tshad myed pa rnams la yang snyoms par 'jug /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang snyoms par 'jug ste/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dbang gis kyang myi skye'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni 'di lta ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi yid la bya ba'i dri ma yongs su dag pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi stobs yongs su dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos gang zhig gi yongs su dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad du smras pa de bzhin no/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa ste/ rab 'byor de ltar chos thams cad yongs su dag pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems zhum pa myed cing 'god pa myed pa de ni/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad kyis ni chos nyid de myi shes myi mthong bas/

sems can de dag gi don du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod/ nang stong pa nyid la spyod/ phyi stong pa nyid la spyod/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod/ chen po stong pa nyid la spyod/ don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la spyod/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la spyod/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la spyod/ dbang po lnga la spyod/ stobs lnga la spyod/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la spyod/ bsam gtan bzhi la spyod/ tshad myed pa bzhi la spyod/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la spyod/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la spyod/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la spyod/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyod/ mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i

stobs bcu la spyod/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi la spyod/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la spyod/ snying rje chen po la spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad la spyod/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la spyod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la spyod/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la spyod/ dgra bcom pa nyid la spyod/ rang byang chub la spyod/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la spyod de/ rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ chos thams cad kyi stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa nyid rab du thob par 'gyur te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar myi ltung ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa dang / g.yo ba rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po'i phyogs gang na 'dzam bu'i chu klung gi gser gyi sa le sbram 'byung ba de lta bu ni nyung ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bslab pa 'di la slob pa'i sems can de lta bu yang nyung ste/ sems can gang nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba de lta bu ni de bas ches mang ngo / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sems can gang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i las yang dag par blangs te gnas pa de lta bu ni nyung ste/ sems can gang khams kyi rgyal phran du 'gyur ba'i las yang dag par blangs shing gnas pa de lta bu ni ches mang ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du sems can gang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'dir 'jug pa de lta bu yang nyung ste/ sems can gang nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba de lta bu ni de bas ches

mang ngo / /rab 'byor gang yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de dag pas ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa de lta bu ches nyung ngo / /de bas kyang sems can gang nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas su gnas par 'gyur ba de lta bu ni ches mang ngo / /rab 'byor gang yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod cing / the tsom myed par phyir myi ldog pa'i sa gnon pa de dag pas ni/ gang phyir myi ldog pa'i sa gnon par 'gyur ba de lta bu ches mang ngo / /rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa'i sa 'thob par 'dod pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sar chud par 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe ser sna dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tshul khrims ngan pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'khrug pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /le lo dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /g.yeng ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /shes rab 'chal pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tha ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /gzugs dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'du shes dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'du byed dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /myig dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rna ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi

skye'o/ /sna dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /lce dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lus dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /yid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /gzugs dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sgra dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dri dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /ro dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /reg dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /chos dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sa'i khams dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /chu'i khams dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /mye'i khams dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rlung gi khams dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /nam

mkha'i khams dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /ma rig pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'du byed dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /mying dang gzugs dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /skye mched drug dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /reg pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tshor ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /sred pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /len pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /srid pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /skye ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rga shi dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /nang stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /

chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /yang dag par spong ba dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dbang po dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /bsam gtan dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sems mi skye'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /myi 'jigs pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sems

myi skye'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rang byang chub dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems myi skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang yang dmyigs pa myed de/ ma dmyigs pas chos gang la yang sems bskyed pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su zin par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang mthun par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'dir pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dus so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na 'jig tshogs su lta bar lta ba'i rnam pa drug cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad kyang 'dus pa yin te/ rab 'byor de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'dir pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dus so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na skyes bu dus byas par gyur ba'i 'tsho ba'i dbang po 'gags pas/ dbang po thams cad 'gags par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dus pa yin

te/ rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu 'gro bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa la slob pa yin na/ /rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni sems can gang ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag mang ba yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams kyang mang ba lags na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad snga phyi myed par myi'i lus thob par gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad re re la yang / sku tshe'i mthar phyin gyi bar du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rgyun ma 'chad par na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang / snyun gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad mang pos bsnyen bkur byas na/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dzin cing 'chad pa dang / klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ de ltar don chen por 'gyur ba ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'o/ /rab 'byor de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems can thams cad kyi bla na myed par 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / sems can mgon myed pa thams cad kyi mgon du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / skyabs myed pa rnams kyi skyabs su 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / gnas myed pa rnams kyi gnas su 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / long ba rnams kyi myig tu 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / mun par gnas pa rnams kyi sgron mar 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba 'thob par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul khong du chud par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pas rnam par rtse bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i nga ro bsgrag par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnga brdung bar 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi dung 'bud par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gtam bya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la bslab par bya'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni/ phun sum tshogs pa gang thob par bya ba de dag las myi 'thob pa gang yang myed do/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi phun sum tshogs pa yang des thob par bgyi ba lags sam/ Rang sangs rgyas kyi phun sum tshogs pa yang des thob par
